findings.title: maybeGrantCover marks a week as cover-granted even when the bank is full
findings.problem: In `maybeGrantCover`, when the student already has `covers === MAX_COVERS` and completes 5 shifts, the function still appends `wk.monday` to `coverWeeks` and returns `granted: false`. The cover count is not increased, so the earned cover is effectively discarded. Because `coverWeeks` now contains that week, a later call in the same week returns early and cannot grant the cover even after the student spends a cover and has room again.
findings.failure_scenario: A student has 2 banked covers, completes 5 shifts in a week, then uses one cover later that same week. At that point `covers` becomes 1, but `coverWeeks` still contains the week's Monday, so `maybeGrantCover` keeps returning early and never restores the cover they earned while at the cap.
findings.fix: Do not append the week to `coverWeeks` unless the cover is actually banked (`rewards.covers < MAX_COVERS`), or otherwise make the same-week spent cover refundable from an earned-but-unrecorded cover.

findings.title: Cover cap regression test misses the lost-earned-cover path
findings.problem: The test for `mayGrantCover` at max covers only asserts `capped.rewards.covers === MAX_COVERS`. It does not assert that `coverWeeks` was left unchanged or that spending a cover later in the same week re-grants the cover. As written, the test passes even though the implementation can lose the earned cover.
findings.failure_scenario: The existing test suite is green, but the defect above is not caught because the test does not exercise the `coverWeeks.includes(monday)` early-return path after a cover is spent.
findings.fix: Add a test that starts with `covers === MAX_COVERS`, completes 5 shifts, then simulates spending a cover and checks whether the cover earned during that week is banked.

findings.title: Persisted `rewards` shape documented out of date: `cardOps` is omitted
findings.problem: The BUILD.md reward bullet lists `prefs` but does not mention `cardOps`, which `src/rewards.js` persists and `migrateRewards`/`mergeRewards` handle. A future integration following the frozen-contract doc may treat `cardOps` as garbage or fail to preserve it.
findings.failure_scenario: A future maintainer writes a task to inspect or migrate the blob using BUILD.md §4 and loses card-operation history because the authoritative-looking shape omits that additive field.
findings.fix: Add an explicit note in the BUILD.md rewards shape that `cardOps` is an optional additive array, or update the authoritative `src/state.js` comment to point to the new location of the authoritative shape.

findings.title: Garbled label in today dashboard
findings.problem: The after version of the today dashboard displays the text 'Day 0-7 to 7' in the streak-shield row. This is a misleading, unreadable label; it appears to be a typo or rendering error (likely intended to be 'Day 0 of 7' or 'Day 0-7'). This is a real defect on a plausible user-facing path.
findings.failure_scenario: A student viewing the Today dashboard sees an incoherent streak-shield status ('Day 0-7 to 7') instead of a clear day indicator, reducing trust in the UI.
findings.fix: Replace the 'Day 0-7 to 7' label with a clear, correct day indicator such as 'Day 0 of 7' or 'Day 0-7'.

assessment:
Text pass: I found one user-facing defect in the new cover system and one documentation gap. I did not find clinical-content errors in the changed warfarin item, and the relabel/revision guard SQL is consistent across migrations and client code.

Picture pass: The after today-dashboard screenshot contains a garbled label ('Day 0-7 to 7') that is a real defect. The other screenshots are unchanged and clinically correct.
